description: This file defines a Spring Boot configuration condition class that evaluates two properties related to batch manager and spring events enablement, based on Spring Boot's conditional configuration mechanisms.

classes.name: SpringEventManagerCondition
classes.description: A class extending AllNestedConditions, used to define complex conditional logic based on properties 'fineract.mode.batch-manager-enabled' and 'fineract.remote-job-message-handler.spring-events.enabled' for enabling configurations related to spring batch event management.

methods.name: SpringEventManagerCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition with the configuration phase set to parse configuration.
